notablePrerequisites:
Mercurial Pretender is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Mercurial Pretender do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Mercurial Pretender.
Activate Mercurial Pretender by tapping it.
When Mercurial Pretender becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Mercurial Pretender's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
